question: Which of the following weightlifters won the BBC Indian Sportswoman of the Year award in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mirabai Chanu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mirabai Chanu:-**

 
 
• She won the BBC Indian Sportswoman of the Year award in 2022 for her outstanding performance in weightlifting.
 
• She won a silver medal in the 49 kg category at the 2021 Tokyo Olympics, becoming the first Indian weightlifter to win a medal at the Olympics in over two decades.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kunjarani Devi:-**

 
 
• She is a former Indian weightlifter who has won several international medals, including the World Weightlifting Championships and the Commonwealth Games.
 
• She retired from competitive weightlifting in 2012.
 
 
 
• **Karnam Malleswari:-**
 
 
• She is a former Indian weightlifter who won a bronze medal at the 2000 Sydney Olympics, becoming the first Indian woman to win an Olympic medal in any sport.
